Customs

退税计划

A customs program allowing for the refund of duties and taxes paid on imported goods that are subsequently exported or used in manufacturing exported products.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 退税计划?

In this glossary, 退税计划 refers to: A customs program allowing for the refund of duties and taxes paid on imported goods that are subsequently exported or used in manufacturing exported products.

How is 退税计划 used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "制造商在出口使用进口零部件生产的产品后，根据退税计划申请了退税。"

Why does 退税计划 matter in logistics?

退税计划 matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses 退税计划?

退税计划 is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does 退税计划 belong to?

In this glossary, 退税计划 is grouped under Customs. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A customs program allowing for the refund of duties and taxes paid on imported goods that are subsequently exported or used in manufacturing exported products.

Operational example

The manufacturer claimed a refund under the drawback scheme after exporting goods made with imported components.
